args.message: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212

args.body:
## Summary
`round_money` in `src/money.py` was using `ROUND_HALF_UP`, contradicting its own docstring and FIN-212, which mandates banker's rounding. The nightly build's `tests/test_money.py` caught this.

## Changes
- Changed `round_money` to use `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` (banker's rounding) to the cent.

## Testing
- CI passed on branch `fix/bankers-rounding-fin-212` (run `ci-0001`), including `tests/test_money.py` which validates half-even behavior for `2.675 -> 2.68` and `2.665 -> 2.66`.
args.head: fix/bankers-rounding-fin-212
